lines.text: VDO.Ninja for Stream Deck lets you run your show from Stream Deck keys and dials. No account, and no extra software.
lines.say: V D O Ninja for Stream Deck lets you run your show from Stream Deck keys and dials. No account, and no extra software.

lines.text: Open your VDO.Ninja page with an API key, and the plugin connects to it. The status key turns green, and the guest list fills in.
lines.say: Open your V D O Ninja page with an A P I key, and the plugin connects to it. The status key turns green, and the guest list fills in.

lines.text: Press a guest's mic key to mute them. The key turns red, and the director page updates right away. Press it again to unmute.
Camera keys work the same way. Turn Bob's video off, and back on.
Scene keys add a guest to a scene, and stay lit while they're in it.
Select Guest picks who your other keys control. Choose Bob, and the Selected Guest mic key now mutes Bob.
Risky actions, like hanging up, ask for a second press. Press again, and Bob leaves. The guest list updates on its own.
Get the free plugin from GitHub, add the Connection Status key, and click Generate secure key to start.
